title: Live thin-turn reconnect reports duplicate seqs after turn.failed
description:
**Found after b3e12c live deploy of #147.**

Worker credential recycle is green: `stale_waiting=409`. The rest of `python/scripts/live_aws_thin_turn.sh development` then exits 1:

```
first_stream_kinds=['turn.started', 'turn.failed'] dropped_mid_stream=False
reconnect_last_event_id=1
resumed_stream_kinds=['turn.failed']
duplicate seqs across drop/reconnect: [1, 2, 2]
```

Lambda URL development ThinTurn. Computers desiredCount 0. Never `--all`.

**Do:** determine whether the greeting turn is failing for a real worker/LLM reason or the reconnect gate is mis-asserting when the first stream never dropped mid-token. One path. Gherkin if it is product.

**Done when:** `cd python && sh scripts/live_aws_thin_turn.sh development` exits 0 against development after a named ChatticusThinTurn deploy.

comments.text: Planning in `/tmp/chatticus-7794b0-reconnect-seq` branch `cursor/live-reconnect-seq-7794b0-4a21`. Diagnose turn.failed vs reconnect assertion. Computers desiredCount 0. Never `--all`.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Two independent problems, and the first one is not in the streaming layer. Check this before spending the cycle on reconnect.**

**1. The turn is failing because development has no OpenAI key at the new parameter name.**

```
aws ssm get-parameter --name /chatticus/development/thin-turn/openai-api-key
ParameterNotFound
```

The old `/amplify/shared/papyrus/OPENAI_API_KEY` still exists, last modified in May. #124 moved the parameter **name** in CDK under 8574c7 and nobody created the parameter at the new location with a value in it. So every model turn in development fails the moment it reaches the provider.

That is exactly the evidence on this card: `first_stream_kinds=['turn.started', 'turn.failed']` with no token chunks between them. The turn starts, reaches for a key that is not there, and fails. There is no LLM problem and no worker problem to find, because the request never gets far enough to have one.

**This is a human action, not an agent one.** Copy the value from the old parameter into `/chatticus/development/thin-turn/openai-api-key` as a `SecureString`. Agents should not read, move, or hold that value. 8574c7's done-when covered the stack deploying without papyrus; it did not cover the secret being present at the new name, which is the gap.

**2. The reconnect assertion is separately wrong, and would still be wrong after the key is fixed.**

```
dropped_mid_stream=False
reconnect_last_event_id=1
resumed_stream_kinds=['turn.failed']
duplicate seqs: [1, 2, 2]
```

The first stream was not dropped. It ran to a terminal event and ended normally. Reconnecting with `after=1` to a turn that has already reached `turn.failed` correctly re-delivers seq 2, so seq 2 appearing twice is the contract working, not a duplicate.

The no-duplicate invariant only means anything across an actual mid-stream drop. Gate the assertion on `dropped_mid_stream` rather than running it unconditionally, or the script will keep failing on healthy turns that simply finished before the reconnect.

**One more thing about this card's parentage.** Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` is 1e389e from Phase 1, not Phase 4 work. This bug is parented to d71ed5, which will keep d71ed5 open for something outside its scope. Once the key is populated, if a real reconnect defect remains, it belongs on its own card rather than holding the live-acceptance card open.
